candidates.fixture_strategy: Use any .docx fixture from the words fixture source configured in words.yml. Standard format conversion — no template-specific requirements.
candidates.expected_output_strategy: Verify output file exists at outputFile path. Optionally verify SaveFormat by checking file extension.
candidates.options_strategy: No options required. Convert(inputFile, outputFile) needs no additional parameters.
candidates.semantic_validation_strategy: Output file size > 0. File extension matches requested format.
candidates.generation_notes: Simplest possible operation_facade usage. File-in/file-out with no dependencies. Highest confidence scenario.

candidates.fixture_strategy: Use any .docx fixture from words fixture source. No template-specific requirements.
candidates.expected_output_strategy: Verify output file exists. Output file size >= input file size (watermark adds content).
candidates.options_strategy: No options required. TextWatermarkOptions is optional — omit for pilot.
candidates.semantic_validation_strategy: Output file exists and is non-empty. Format preserved (same extension as input).
candidates.generation_notes: String constant watermark text eliminates all data dependencies. Watermark image overloads (SKBitmap) MUST NOT be selected — use SetText only.

required_inputs: one .docx fixture file (must have at least 1 page)
candidates.fixture_strategy: Use any .docx fixture from words fixture source. startPageIndex=0, pageCount=1 to extract first page — safe for any document.
candidates.expected_output_strategy: Verify output file exists and is non-empty.
candidates.options_strategy: No options required. ExtractPages uses integer page range only.
candidates.semantic_validation_strategy: Output file exists, non-empty. File is smaller than or equal to input (only first page extracted).
candidates.generation_notes: Splitter.Split() is blocked by SplitCriteria enum. ExtractPages bypasses the options requirement entirely — safer and equally demonstrative.

candidates.fixture_strategy: Use any .docx fixture. Pattern can be a common English word likely to appear in any fixture (e.g., 'the' or 'document'). Zero replacements is valid — no exception thrown.
candidates.expected_output_strategy: Verify output file exists. Return value (Int32 replacement count) is logged but can be 0.
candidates.options_strategy: No options required. String-based Replace() with no SaveOptions.
candidates.semantic_validation_strategy: Output file exists. File size approximately equal to input (minor delta from replacement). Return value >= 0.
candidates.generation_notes: Pattern mismatch is safe — returns 0 but does not throw. Use a common English word pattern to maximize chances of replacement. Regex overload is also available but string overload preferred for simplicity.

candidates.fixture_strategy: Standard .docx fixture. Fixture must have multiple sections/pages for meaningful split.
candidates.options_strategy: SplitOptions requires SplitCriteria enum value. Enum values not in catalog.
candidates.blocked_reason: SplitCriteria enum values not available in API catalog. Cannot safely set SplitOptions.SplitCriteria without knowing valid values. Use WORDS-003 (ExtractPages) as workaround.
candidates.generation_notes: Add SplitCriteria enum enumeration step to unblock this scenario in a future sprint.

required_outputs: comparison output file with tracked changes
candidates.fixture_strategy: Two distinct .docx fixture files needed. Current fixture sources may provide only one per scenario.
candidates.options_strategy: No options required for simplest overload.
candidates.semantic_validation_strategy: Output file exists and contains tracked changes.
candidates.blocked_reason: Requires TWO input fixture files. Current fixture strategy assumes one fixture per scenario. Fixture source configuration must be extended to provide paired fixtures.
candidates.generation_notes: Once fixture strategy supports paired fixtures, this scenario can proceed. Author and DateTime can be constants.

candidates.fixture_strategy: Multiple .docx fixture files needed. Current fixture strategy may not provide multiple fixtures per scenario.
candidates.expected_output_strategy: Verify output file exists and is non-empty.
candidates.options_strategy: No options required for simplest overload.
candidates.semantic_validation_strategy: Output file size approximately >= sum of input file sizes.
candidates.blocked_reason: Requires 2+ input fixture files. Current fixture strategy assumes one fixture per scenario.
candidates.generation_notes: Same fixture strategy blocker as Comparer. Resolve WORDS-006 fixture strategy to unblock this.

candidates.fixture_strategy: Template fixture must have merge fields (e.g., <<FirstName>>, <<LastName>>). fieldNames must match exactly.
candidates.semantic_validation_strategy: Merge field placeholders replaced in output.
candidates.blocked_reason: Template+data coupling: merge field names in the template fixture are unknown without fixture introspection. Cannot generate fieldNames[] values without knowing what merge fields exist in the specific fixture. LLM cannot safely assume merge field names.
candidates.generation_notes: To unblock: add fixture metadata specifying merge field names, or provide a specific fixture whose merge fields are known and documented in the scenario config.

candidates.fixture_strategy: Template fixture must have LINQ expressions (e.g., <<[items]>>, <<[Name]>>). Data object properties must match.
candidates.semantic_validation_strategy: Template expressions replaced with data values.
candidates.blocked_reason: LINQ template + data object coupling: template expressions are unknown without fixture introspection. Data object structure must match template exactly. LLM cannot safely infer LINQ template structure from fixture alone.
candidates.generation_notes: To unblock: document template structure in fixture metadata, or provide specific fixture+data pairs with documented schema.

candidates.options_strategy: No options required for basic From/To/Execute usage.
candidates.semantic_validation_strategy: Output file exists and is non-empty.
